title: Bladerunner Sydney Taxi vibes
author: AlgaeNo3373
selftext:
Been working on this for about a week. There aren't many video games representing Australia, so I wanted to have a crack at it. The focus so far is trying to get some good visuals going so there's no cab gameplay yet, but part of that is getting landmarks in-game as pickup/drop-off points and I have about 30 scattered around inner sydney so far. I'm wanting to really focus on lighting and a painterly/impressionist effect to kind smooth over the edges, still figuring that part out tbh\~

Work is a mix of Claude/GPT models - Opus 5.5 on active duty during the day, and Sol 6.1 left on some unattended overnight runs to add landmarks.
